claims.statement: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation requires producer registers and extended producer responsibility for packaging first made available in a Member State.

The regulation's reporting design includes producer identifiers, reporting periods, packaging quantities by weight and category, and interoperable machine-readable formats, creating a recurring data-reconciliation task.

Hypothesis: brands operating in three or more EU markets will pay for a single evidence ledger even when filings remain country-specific, especially if it reconciles producer-responsibility invoices to actual shipments.

contrary_evidence: The regulation seeks harmonised and open reporting formats, which may let ERP, marketplace, or accounting vendors add basic reporting cheaply.
Extended producer-responsibility implementation and fees remain country-specific, increasing service burden and legal-review costs.

economics.acquisition_route: Revenue-share referrals from 3PLs and accountants, free packaging-liability calculators, and integration-directory listings
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 300 brands at a 1,800 PLN average monthly fee yields about 6.5m PLN ARR before onboarding; a profitable majority-owned compliance ledger could exceed 5m PLN founder equity in four to seven years
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly for the initial country corridor; maintain under 10 hours by partnering for local legal interpretation
economics.gross_margin_basis: Core reconciliation software can exceed 80% gross margin; country-specific filing support may reduce blended margin to 60-75%
economics.payback: Avoided overpayment, averted filing rework, or saved finance time should repay fees within one reporting cycle; target CAC payback under nine months
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 600-3,000 PLN monthly per brand depending on countries and order volume, plus 3,000-12,000 PLN onboarding
economics.retention_or_repeat: Reporting repeats annually or more often, while SKU and country expansion increases account value

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A versioned graph of SKU packaging, fulfilment variants, destinations, filed quantities, corrections, and fee outcomes
fingerprint.customer: Emerging consumer brands and e-commerce sellers shipping packaged goods into multiple EU Member States
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: 3PL, accounting, marketplace-agency, and producer-responsibility-organisation referrals embedded at cross-border launch
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: SKU-level packaging data ledger, order reconciliation, reporting exports, and evidence vault sold as SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Brand pays monthly by country and order volume, plus optional onboarding and filing-support fees
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A brand enters a new country, prepares an EPR report, receives a fee discrepancy, or changes packaging

founder_fit: Strong data-pipeline and FMCG-adjacent fit, provided the founder uses no employer information or relationships. It is asynchronous, automatable, and can start with one corridor such as Poland-Germany-Czechia through accountants and 3PLs.
risks: Incorrect weight or destination mapping can cause under-reporting and penalties.
Country expansion may become a consulting-heavy trap.
A major e-commerce platform could provide bundled compliance to its merchants.

structure.control_point: The canonical mapping from each shipped order to packaging liability and filed evidence
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate packaging bills of materials and reliable country-specific reporting interpretation

thesis: Build a transaction-linked packaging ledger for Polish and Central European brands selling across several EU countries. It maps each SKU and fulfilment configuration to packaging materials and destination, reconciles quantities to producer-responsibility registrations and invoices, and produces country-ready reports. Its moat is the longitudinal SKU-order-country compliance graph and correction history embedded with fulfilment partners.
title: Cross-Border Packaging Ledger for Emerging Brands
uncertainties: The smallest cross-border seller with enough complexity and budget to buy.
Whether 3PL and marketplace order data exposes packaging configuration reliably.
Which filing activities can be automated without acting as a regulated or legally responsible representative.
